column1: # w-fenceb GRID 3 — the HOLD-OUT for R1', frozen BY CONTENT HASH in PREREG.md §0
# before the first `cl.exe` of this lane. `w-keygen` (board #2966) froze a
# hold-out by NAME and its population moved -10.8 % underneath it while the file
# stayed byte-identical; the sha256 is what makes this a hold-out.
# THE DESIGN IS A CROSS, and the cross is the point. `w-backedge` found that NO
# grid1 cell had two backward references to ONE target, so per-reference and
# per-target were STRUCTURALLY UNSEPARABLE there. Grid 3 is
#     {while, for, do/while}  x  {continue count 0,1,2}  x  {break count 0,1,2}
# thinned to the 16 cells that carry information, plus a named-`goto` family and
# three must-be-zero controls. Every `continue` cell is a candidate
# DISCRIMINATOR (two backward references, one backward target); the instrument
# prints how many cells actually discriminated, so "no cells" is a loud failure
# EIGHT CELLS REPRODUCE A CELL ALREADY COMPILED BY `w-backedge` and are marked
# `# repro` — they are the instrument's controls, NOT hold-out scoring, and they
# are excluded from every held-out score. The remaining fifteen have never been
# Columns: name <TAB> class <TAB> probe body.   Probe: `int P(int a){ <body> }`.

column3: int r=0; while (a) { r=r+a; a=a-1; } return r;
int r=0; while (a) { a=a-1; if (a==5) continue; r=r+a; } return r;
int r=0; while (a) { a=a-1; if (a==5) continue; if (a==7) continue; r=r+a; } return r;
int r=0; while (a) { a=a-1; if (a==2) break; r=r+a; } return r;
int r=0; while (a) { a=a-1; if (a==2) break; if (a==4) break; r=r+a; } return r;
int r=0; while (a) { a=a-1; if (a==5) continue; if (a==2) break; r=r+a; } return r;
int r=0; for (int i=0;i<a;i=i+1) r=r+i; return r;
int r=0; for (int i=0;i<a;i=i+1) { if (i==3) continue; r=r+i; } return r;
int r=0; for (int i=0;i<a;i=i+1) { if (i==3) continue; if (i==5) continue; r=r+i; } return r;
int r=0; for (int i=0;i<a;i=i+1) { if (i==3) break; r=r+i; } return r;
int r=0; for (int i=0;i<a;i=i+1) { if (i==3) break; if (i==5) break; r=r+i; } return r;
int r=0; for (int i=0;i<a;i=i+1) { if (i==3) continue; if (i==5) break; r=r+i; } return r;
int r=0; do { r=r+a; a=a-1; } while (a); return r;
int r=0; do { a=a-1; if (a==5) continue; r=r+a; } while (a); return r;
int r=0; do { a=a-1; if (a==2) break; r=r+a; } while (a); return r;
int r=0; do { a=a-1; if (a==5) continue; if (a==2) break; r=r+a; } while (a); return r;
